description: Compare locli with the app files from locli.json: a key locli lists for a platform (e.g. Android) that no catalog of that platform here contains loses that platform in locli, so pull stops writing it there; its texts stay stored. Only platforms with a target in locli.json are checked, so a platform whose app lives in another repository is never touched. A key never loses its last platform; those are listed as unused (delete them with locli_delete_keys if no other repository uses them). Run with dryRun first and show the user the list.
name: locli_key_platforms
title: Drop platforms keys are not used on
